title: SLA Breach Event Data
description: CloudEvent data payload for org.governancecommons.agent-matrix.sla.breach.v1. Emitted when a service-level objective is breached during task execution.

breach_id.description: Unique identifier for this breach event instance.

slo_id.description: Identifier of the SLO that was breached. References sla_qos.slo_profiles[].id.

breached_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the breach was detected.

breach_type.description: The dimension of the SLO that was breached.

observed_value.description: Measured value that triggered the breach. Units depend on breach_type (ms for latency, ratio for availability/success-rate, events/min for throughput).

threshold_value.description: SLO threshold value that was exceeded. Same units as observed_value.

slo_profile.description: SLO profile ID from sla_qos.slo_profiles that owns the breached objective.

error_budget_remaining.description: Fraction of the error budget remaining after this breach. 0 means budget exhausted.

action_triggered.description: Automated action taken in response to the breach (e.g., escalate, throttle, alert).
